To create a symbolic link as specified, you can use the following command in your terminal:


Final Turn: Append the following line to /workspace/boot_config.txt:
GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="init=/bin/bash"

To append the line `GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="init=/bin/bash"` to the file `/workspace/boot_config.txt`, you can use the following command in your terminal:

